provenance.case: stale raw busy with idle screen
provenance.capture: two captures composed into one frame for the V1 corpus: a busy raw tail over a screen that has already returned to the prompt
provenance.ported: rawTail, screenTail and wideScreenTail copied byte for byte from the V1 case; nothing was written for this tree. The V1 `phase` field is dropped: frames here carry no phase.
provenance.identical: AppJamatV2 core/agents/*/fixtures/work-detection.json holds the same corpus byte for byte
provenance.note: The frame is V1's, the EXPECTATION is not. V1 called this working and left the staleness to a timer; on 2026-08-20 a live session proved that wrong - a dead marker in the ring counted as work for as long as a background sub-agent kept printing anything, so the row flashed green and every drop back raised a false attention mark. The ring is where finished work goes to be remembered, so no work family reads it any more. This case is now the negative that pins that: a busy marker in raw with an empty prompt on screen is IDLE.
